newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Olympia gambles on S.Africa, Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: Olympia gambles on S.Africa, Cambodia.

text.p: Malaysia's Olympia Industries Bhd said on Monday that it has ventured into the casino business in South Africa and will operate lottery games in Cambodia.
In a statement, the company said its LC (BVI) Ltd unit has teamed up with South African merchant bank Rand Merchant Bank Ltd to bid for several new casino licences in South Africa.

Related to this, Olympia said LC (BVI) has concluded an agreement to subscribe to one-third of the issued share capital of Global Resorts S.A. (Pty) Ltd in South Africa for about $2.18 million. Global Resorts operates the 200-room Grand Palm Hotel & Casino Resort in Gaborone, Botswana.
Global Resorts has also recently been awarded a gaming licence to operate a casino in Secunda, southeast of Johannesburg.
The other two equal shareholders of Global Resorts are Rand Merchant Bank and Genbel Securities Ltd.
Global Resorts is also seeking to run casino hotel facilities in the Cape Town and Johannesburg areas in South Africa.

In Cambodia, LC (BVI) Ltd has subscribed up to 18,750 ordinary shares at a par value of $10 in the issued share capital of Lotto Corp Cambodia Co Ltd, representing 75 percent of its issued share capital.

Lotto Corp, with an authorised share capital of $1 million, has been awarded a lottery licence for 25 years by the minister of economy and finance to operate and conduct Lotto, Lotteries, 4-Digit and Computerised-Digit Games in Cambodia.
Olympia said it expects the operation of the lottery business in Cambodia will start in May 1997.
Olympia's stock has been suspended for news announcements. It last traded at 2.45 ringgit on January 24.
